chapters.nameEn: Cosmological Baseline & the Ujjayinī Prime Meridian
chapters.overview: The prime meridian of the Sūrya-Siddhānta tradition — SS 1.62 names the line through Laṅkā, Rohītaka and Avantī (Ujjayinī) — and the deśāntara longitude-time correction. The snippet converts UT to local mean time at a given longitude (75.7885° E, the Ujjain longitude used in this snippet).

slokas.deva:
उज्जयिनी मध्यरेखा लङ्कायाः समसूत्रगा ।
यतः कालस्य गणना यतो देशान्तरादि च ॥
slokas.translit:
ujjayinī madhyarekhā laṅkāyāḥ samasūtragā |
yataḥ kālasya gaṇanā yato deśāntarādi ca ||

anvaya.en: The Ujjayini Prime Meridian ($0^\circ$ geodetic reference)
Aligned on the exact meridian orthogonal to the equator at Lanka

slokas.translation: The prime meridian of Ujjayinī, aligned with Laṅkā, is the line from which time and longitude (deśāntara) are reckoned. [The verse is not located in any text in this repository.]
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation.

chapters.overview: Time units from the Paramāṇu (29.629 µs in this synthesis) up to the prāṇa — a unit of time (SS 1.11), traditionally glossed as one breath — and the count correspondence 21,600 prāṇa a day ↔ 21,600 kalā (arcminutes) a circle (60 × 60 × 6 = 360 × 60 = 108 × 200).

slokas.deva:
द्वौ परमाणू स्यादणुस्त्रसरेणुस्त्रिभिस्तथा ।
त्रसरेणुत्रयं त्रुटिर्ज्ञेया वेधः शतत्रुटिः ॥
षष्ट्या प्राणैर्भवेत् षष्टी घटिकानां तथाऽहोरात्रम् ॥
slokas.translit:
dvau paramāṇū syādaṇustrasareṇustribhistathā |
trasareṇutrayaṃ truṭirjñeyā vedhaḥ śatatruṭiḥ ||

anvaya.en: 1 day = 21,600 prāṇas (time units) = 21,600 arcminutes in a circle (count correspondence)

slokas.translation: 2 Paramāṇus make 1 Aṇu; 3 Aṇus make 1 Trasareṇu; 3 Trasareṇus make 1 Truṭi ($29.629\,\mu\text{s}$ in this synthesis). 21,600 prāṇas (units of time) make one day; the circle has 21,600 arcminutes — a count correspondence.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation.

formula.title: Prāṇa–Kalā count correspondence
formula.notes: A count correspondence (21,600 prāṇa per day; 21,600 arcminutes per circle). No physiological claim.

chapters.codeSnippet:
def prana_to_arcminute(prana_count):
    return prana_count * 1.0 # 1 Prana = exactly 1 Arcminute of rotation
chapters.codeOutput:
prana_to_arcminute(21600) → 21600.0 arcminutes = 360°
(the snippet maps 1 prāṇa → 1 arcminute of rotation)
Computed by executing this snippet (Python 3).

chapters.overview: Decodes the mathematical architecture of the Vedic Samhitas: Rigveda 1.164 (Asya Vamasya Sukta - 360 spokes of the cosmic wheel), Yajurveda 27 Nakshatra hymns, and Atharvaveda 19.7 stellar stutis.

slokas.deva:
द्वादश प्रधयश्चक्रमेकं त्रीणि नभ्यानि क उ तच्चिकेता ।
तस्मिन्त्साकं त्रिशता न शङ्कवोऽर्पिताः षष्टिश्च न चलाचलासः ॥
slokas.translit:
dvādaśa pradhayaścakramekaṃ trīṇi nabhyāni ka u tacciketā |
tasmintsākaṃ triśatā na śaṅkavo'rpitāḥ ṣaṣṭiśca na calācalāsaḥ ||

anvaya.en: 360 spokes (days / degrees) firmly fixed without drifting

slokas.translation: The wheel of cosmic time has twelve fellies, one axle, and three hubs. Fixed within it are three hundred and sixty spokes that never become loose.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation.

chapters.overview: The mathematical physics of consciousness and non-dual cosmology in the Prashna, Mandukya (4 states of consciousness ↔ 4 coordinates), and Chandogya Upanishads.

slokas.deva:
पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते ।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥
slokas.translit:
pūrṇamadaḥ pūrṇamidaṃ pūrṇātpūrṇamudacyate |
pūrṇasya pūrṇamādāya pūrṇamevāvaśiṣyate ||

anvaya.en: Infinity alone remains as invariant ground

slokas.translation: That is infinite, this is infinite. From the infinite, the infinite emerges. When infinity is taken from infinity, infinity alone remains.
slokas.source: editions/maha-grantha-full-edition.html — quoted there (the śānti-pāṭha «पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदम्»); the Upaniṣad locus is not given in this repository.

chapters.overview: Decodes the grand multi-billion-year timelines in the Bhagavata, Vishnu, and Matsya Puranas: 14 Manvantaras (306,720,000 years each), 71 Mahayugas per Manvantara, Sandhi twilight intervals, and Kalpa grand alignment.

slokas.deva:
चतुर्युगसहस्रं तु ब्रह्मणो दिनमुच्यते ।
तावत्येव भवेद् रात्रिः कल्पसंज्ञा च सा स्मृता ॥
slokas.translit:
caturyugasahasraṃ tu brahmaṇo dinamucyate |
tāvatyeva bhaved rātriḥ kalpasaṃjñā ca sā smṛtā ||

anvaya.en: One day of Brahma = 4.32 Billion Years = 1 Kalpa

slokas.translation: One thousand Mahayugas constitute one day of Brahma (4.32 billion years), and his night is of equal duration.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation.

formula.title: Kalpa Structure Invariant Equation
formula.notes: Exact integer summation perfectly preserves 1,000 Mahayuga total.

chapters.codeSnippet:
def compute_kalpa_years():
    manvantaras = 14 * 71 * 4320000
    sandhis = 15 * 1728000
    return manvantaras + sandhis
chapters.codeOutput:
14 × 71 × 4,320,000 = 4,294,080,000 years (manvantaras)
15 × 1,728,000 = 25,920,000 years (sandhis)
compute_kalpa_years() → 4,320,000,000 years (= 1,000 Mahāyugas of 4,320,000 years)
Computed by executing this snippet (Python 3).

chapters.overview: The mathematical geometry of Sri Chakra: 9 interlocking triangles generating 43 subsidiary triangles, 14 Marma intersections, 54 Sandhi confluence vertices, and golden-ratio $(\phi)$ logarithmic scaling.

slokas.deva:
बिन्दुत्रिकोणवसुकोणदशारयुग्ममन्वस्रनागदलसंयुतषोडशारम् ।
वृत्तत्रयं च धरणीसदनत्रयं च श्रीचक्रमेतदुदितं परदेवतायाः ॥
slokas.translit:
bindutrikoṇavasukoṇadaśārayugmamanvasranāgadalasaṃyutaṣoḍaśāram |
vṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇīsadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametaduditaṃ paradevatāyāḥ ||

anvaya.en: The Sri Yantra matrix (Bindu, Trikona, Ashtakona, 2x Dashara, Chaturdashara, Ashtadala, Shodashadala, Bhupura)

slokas.translation: The Sri Chakra comprises the central Bindu, primary triangle, 8-angled star, twin 10-angled rings, 14-angled ring, 8 and 16 lotus petals, 3 concentric circles, and 3-tiered Bhupura earth gateway.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation.

chapters.overview: An interpretive essay on astronomical statements associated with the Mahābhārata (Kṛttikā eclipse pairs, Saturn near Rohiṇī, the lunar days of Balarāma's pilgrimage). No ephemeris computation is done here: the snippet only returns the Julian Day of the Kali-yuga epoch.

slokas.deva:
त्रयोदश्यां प्रवृत्तेऽहनि पौर्णमास्यां तथैव च ।
चन्द्रसूर्यावुभौ ग्रस्तौ एकमासे प्रपश्यतः ॥
slokas.translit:
trayodaśyāṃ pravṛtte'hani paurṇamāsyāṃ tathaiva ca |
candrasūryāvubhau grastau ekamāse prapaśyataḥ ||

anvaya.en: both (Moon and Sun) seized in one month — read as two eclipses within one month

slokas.translation: The passage is read as saying that both the Moon and the Sun were eclipsed within one month (its words name a trayodaśī and a full moon). It is printed here without a located source and is not a statement of historical fact.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no Mahābhārata text is in this repository; the verse is not located and is not evidence of a historical eclipse.

chapters.overview: A SHA-256 hash of a state string (Julian Day and longitudes): identical inputs give an identical hash, so a recorded state can be re-checked. Integer rings ℤ/3ᵏℤ are discussed in the synthesis; the snippet itself only hashes its input.

slokas.deva:
शून्यमेव परं तत्त्वं निष्कलं निरवग्रहम् ।
यस्मात् सर्वं समुद्भूतं यस्मिंश्च प्रविलीयते ॥
slokas.translit:
śūnyameva paraṃ tattvaṃ niṣkalaṃ niravagraham |
yasmāt sarvaṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasmiṃśca pravilīyate ||

anvaya.en: Śūnya (Zero / Ground state of zero entropy)

slokas.translation: Śūnya is the supreme unfragmented principle, from which all coordinate manifolds arise and into which all numbers resolve without information loss.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation.
